verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent stack, as documented, is buyer-side. Agent Cards, Agent Wallets and Agent Checkouts let an agent pay a merchant, and Agent Checkouts works with 'any merchant' without the merchant doing anything. Its x402 and MPP docs cover paying protected endpoints, not publishing them. The pack shows no merchant setting, agreement or endpoint-publishing path for accepting agent traffic. Its general headless checkout is an adjacent feature, not agent-traffic enablement.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint
